package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.IncidentRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.workflow.engine.service.ProcessRuntimeService;
import org.flowable.engine.runtime.ProcessInstance;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * BusinessService para Incidentes según EU AI Act Art. 20.1
 *
 * Gestiona reporte y seguimiento de incidentes durante monitoreo post-mercado.
 * Los incidentes de severidad HIGH o CRITICAL se notifican automáticamente a autoridades.
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class IncidentService {

    @Autowired
    private IncidentRepository repository;

    @Autowired
    private ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;

    /**
     * Reporta un incidente
     * Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)
     * 
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param severity Severidad del incidente (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)
     * @param description Descripción del incidente
     * @param impact Impacto del incidente (opcional)
     * @param reportedBy Usuario que reporta el incidente
     * @return Incidente creado
     */
    public Incident reportIncident(Long projectId, String severity, String description, String impact, String reportedBy) {
        log.info("Reporting incident for project: {} with severity: {}", projectId, severity);

        Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

        Incident incident = new Incident();
        incident.setProject(project);
        incident.setIncseverity(severity);
        incident.setIncdescription(description);
        incident.setIncincidentdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        incident.setIncstatus("OPEN");
        incident.setInccreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        incident.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        incident.setIncauthoritynotified(false);
        incident.setIncusersnotified(false);

        incident = repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Incident created with ID: {}", incident.getIdxincident());

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para gestión del incidente
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerIncidentWorkflow(incident, reportedBy);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Incident workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incident.getIdxincident(), workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching incident workflow for incident: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            // No fallar la creación del incidente si el workflow falla
        }

        // Si severidad >= HIGH, notificar autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)
        if ("HIGH".equals(data.getSeverity()) || "CRITICAL".equals(data.getSeverity())) {
            notifyAuthority(incident.getIdxincident(), reportedBy);
        }

        return incident;
    }

    /**
     * Notifica a autoridades
     */
    public void notifyAuthority(Long incidentId, String notifiedBy) {
        log.info("Notifying authority for incident: {} by {}", incidentId, notifiedBy);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncauthoritynotified(true);
        incident.setIncauthoritynotifiedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Authority notified for incident: {}", incidentId);

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerAuthorityNotificationWorkflow(incident, notifiedBy);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Authority notification workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incidentId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching authority notification workflow for incident: {}", incidentId, e);
            // No fallar la notificación si el workflow falla
        }

        // TODO: Enviar notificación real a autoridades
        // authorityNotificationService.sendNotification(incident);
    }

    /**
     * Notifica usuarios afectados
     */
    public void notifyUsers(Long incidentId) {
        log.info("Notifying users for incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncusersnotified(true);

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Users notified for incident: {}", incidentId);

        // TODO: Enviar notificación real a usuarios
    }

    /**
     * Realiza análisis de causa raíz
     */
    public void performRCA(Long incidentId, String rcaAnalysis) {
        log.info("Performing RCA for incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncrca(rcaAnalysis);
        incident.setIncstatus("INVESTIGATING");

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("RCA completed for incident: {}", incidentId);

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para análisis de causa raíz
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerRCAWorkflow(incident);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("RCA workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incidentId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching RCA workflow for incident: {}", incidentId, e);
            // No fallar el RCA si el workflow falla
        }
    }

    /**
     * Cierra incidente
     */
    public void closeIncident(Long incidentId) {
        log.info("Closing incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncstatus("CLOSED");

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Incident closed: {}", incidentId);

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerIncidentClosureWorkflow(incident);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Incident closure workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incidentId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching incident closure workflow for incident: {}", incidentId, e);
            // No fallar el cierre si el workflow falla
        }
    }

    /**
     * Busca incidentes con filtros
     */
    public List<Incident> findByFilters(String severity, String status, Long projectId, String search) {
        log.info("Finding incidents with filters - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);
        return repository.findByFilters(projectId, severity, status, search);
    }

    /**
     * Busca incidente por ID
     */
    public Incident findById(Long incidentId) {
        return repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));
    }

    /**
     * Cuenta incidentes activos
     */
    public long countActiveIncidents() {
        return repository.countActiveIncidents();
    }

    /**
     * Clase de datos para reporte de incidente
     */
    public static class IncidentData {
        private String severity;
        private String description;
        private String impact;

        public String getSeverity() { return severity; }
        public void setSeverity(String severity) { this.severity = severity; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
        public String getImpact() { return impact; }
        public void setImpact(String impact) { this.impact = impact; }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para gestión de incidente
     *
     * @param incident Incidente reportado
     * @param reportedBy Usuario que reportó el incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerIncidentWorkflow(Incident incident, String reportedBy) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para incidente: incidentId={}, severity={}",
                incident.getIdxincident(), incident.getIncseverity());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("severity", incident.getIncseverity());
            variables.put("description", incident.getIncdescription());
            variables.put("incidentDate", incident.getIncincidentdate() != null ?
                    LocalDateTime.ofInstant(incident.getIncincidentdate().toInstant(),
                            java.time.ZoneId.systemDefault()).toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("status", incident.getIncstatus());
            variables.put("reportedBy", reportedBy);
            variables.put("requiresAuthorityNotification",
                    "HIGH".equals(incident.getIncseverity()) || "CRITICAL".equals(incident.getIncseverity()));

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-incident-management-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para incidente: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @param notifiedBy Usuario que notifica
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerAuthorityNotificationWorkflow(Incident incident, String notifiedBy) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades: incidentId={}",
                incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("severity", incident.getIncseverity());
            variables.put("notificationDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("notifiedBy", notifiedBy);

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-authority-notification-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades: {}",
                    incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para análisis de causa raíz (RCA)
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerRCAWorkflow(Incident incident) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para RCA: incidentId={}", incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("rcaAnalysis", incident.getIncrca());
            variables.put("rcaDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-rca-analysis-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para RCA: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerIncidentClosureWorkflow(Incident incident) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente: incidentId={}",
                incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("closureDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("finalStatus", incident.getIncstatus());

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-incident-closure-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente: {}",
                    incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }
}

        public void setSeverity(String severity) { this.severity = severity; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
        public String getImpact() { return impact; }
        public void setImpact(String impact) { this.impact = impact; }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para gestión de incidente
     *
     * @param incident Incidente reportado
     * @param reportedBy Usuario que reportó el incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerIncidentWorkflow(Incident incident, String reportedBy) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para incidente: incidentId={}, severity={}",
                incident.getIdxincident(), incident.getIncseverity());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("severity", incident.getIncseverity());
            variables.put("description", incident.getIncdescription());
            variables.put("incidentDate", incident.getIncincidentdate() != null ?
                    LocalDateTime.ofInstant(incident.getIncincidentdate().toInstant(),
                            java.time.ZoneId.systemDefault()).toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("status", incident.getIncstatus());
            variables.put("reportedBy", reportedBy);
            variables.put("requiresAuthorityNotification",
                    "HIGH".equals(incident.getIncseverity()) || "CRITICAL".equals(incident.getIncseverity()));

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-incident-management-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para incidente: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @param notifiedBy Usuario que notifica
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerAuthorityNotificationWorkflow(Incident incident, String notifiedBy) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades: incidentId={}",
                incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("severity", incident.getIncseverity());
            variables.put("notificationDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("notifiedBy", notifiedBy);

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-authority-notification-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades: {}",
                    incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para análisis de causa raíz (RCA)
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerRCAWorkflow(Incident incident) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para RCA: incidentId={}", incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("rcaAnalysis", incident.getIncrca());
            variables.put("rcaDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-rca-analysis-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para RCA: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerIncidentClosureWorkflow(Incident incident) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente: incidentId={}",
                incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {

                    incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.IncidentRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.workflow.engine.service.ProcessRuntimeService;
import org.flowable.engine.runtime.ProcessInstance;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * BusinessService para Incidentes según EU AI Act Art. 20.1
 *
 * Gestiona reporte y seguimiento de incidentes durante monitoreo post-mercado.
 * Los incidentes de severidad HIGH o CRITICAL se notifican automáticamente a autoridades.
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class IncidentService {

    @Autowired
    private IncidentRepository repository;

    @Autowired
    private ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;

    /**
     * Reporta un incidente
     * Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)
     * 
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param severity Severidad del incidente (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)
     * @param description Descripción del incidente
     * @param impact Impacto del incidente (opcional)
     * @param reportedBy Usuario que reporta el incidente
     * @return Incidente creado
     */
    public Incident reportIncident(Long projectId, String severity, String description, String impact, String reportedBy) {
        log.info("Reporting incident for project: {} with severity: {}", projectId, severity);

        Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

        Incident incident = new Incident();
        incident.setProject(project);
        incident.setIncseverity(severity);
        incident.setIncdescription(description);
        incident.setIncincidentdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        incident.setIncstatus("OPEN");
        incident.setInccreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        incident.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        incident.setIncauthoritynotified(false);
        incident.setIncusersnotified(false);

        incident = repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Incident created with ID: {}", incident.getIdxincident());

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para gestión del incidente
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerIncidentWorkflow(incident, reportedBy);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Incident workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incident.getIdxincident(), workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching incident workflow for incident: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            // No fallar la creación del incidente si el workflow falla
        }

        // Si severidad >= HIGH, notificar autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)
        if ("HIGH".equals(severity) || "CRITICAL".equals(severity)) {
            notifyAuthority(incident.getIdxincident(), reportedBy);
        }

        return incident;
    }

    /**
     * Notifica a autoridades
     */
    public void notifyAuthority(Long incidentId, String notifiedBy) {
        log.info("Notifying authority for incident: {} by {}", incidentId, notifiedBy);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncauthoritynotified(true);
        incident.setIncauthoritynotifiedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Authority notified for incident: {}", incidentId);

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerAuthorityNotificationWorkflow(incident, notifiedBy);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Authority notification workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incidentId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching authority notification workflow for incident: {}", incidentId, e);
            // No fallar la notificación si el workflow falla
        }

        // TODO: Enviar notificación real a autoridades
        // authorityNotificationService.sendNotification(incident);
    }

    /**
     * Notifica usuarios afectados
     */
    public void notifyUsers(Long incidentId) {
        log.info("Notifying users for incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncusersnotified(true);

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Users notified for incident: {}", incidentId);

        // TODO: Enviar notificación real a usuarios
    }

    /**
     * Realiza análisis de causa raíz
     */
    public void performRCA(Long incidentId, String rcaAnalysis) {
        log.info("Performing RCA for incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncrca(rcaAnalysis);
        incident.setIncstatus("INVESTIGATING");

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("RCA completed for incident: {}", incidentId);

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para análisis de causa raíz
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerRCAWorkflow(incident);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("RCA workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incidentId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching RCA workflow for incident: {}", incidentId, e);
            // No fallar el RCA si el workflow falla
        }
    }

    /**
     * Cierra incidente
     */
    public void closeIncident(Long incidentId) {
        log.info("Closing incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));

        incident.setIncstatus("CLOSED");

        repository.save(incident);
        log.info("Incident closed: {}", incidentId);

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerIncidentClosureWorkflow(incident);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Incident closure workflow BPMN launched: incidentId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        incidentId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching incident closure workflow for incident: {}", incidentId, e);
            // No fallar el cierre si el workflow falla
        }
    }

    /**
     * Busca incidentes con filtros
     */
    public List<Incident> findByFilters(String severity, String status, Long projectId, String search) {
        log.info("Finding incidents with filters - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);
        return repository.findByFilters(projectId, severity, status, search);
    }

    /**
     * Busca incidente por ID
     */
    public Incident findById(Long incidentId) {
        return repository.findById(incidentId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId));
    }

    /**
     * Cuenta incidentes activos
     */
    public long countActiveIncidents() {
        return repository.countActiveIncidents();
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para gestión de incidente
     *
     * @param incident Incidente reportado
     * @param reportedBy Usuario que reportó el incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerIncidentWorkflow(Incident incident, String reportedBy) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para incidente: incidentId={}, severity={}",
                incident.getIdxincident(), incident.getIncseverity());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("severity", incident.getIncseverity());
            variables.put("description", incident.getIncdescription());
            variables.put("incidentDate", incident.getIncincidentdate() != null ?
                    LocalDateTime.ofInstant(incident.getIncincidentdate().toInstant(),
                            java.time.ZoneId.systemDefault()).toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("status", incident.getIncstatus());
            variables.put("reportedBy", reportedBy);
            variables.put("requiresAuthorityNotification",
                    "HIGH".equals(incident.getIncseverity()) || "CRITICAL".equals(incident.getIncseverity()));

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-incident-management-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para incidente: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @param notifiedBy Usuario que notifica
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerAuthorityNotificationWorkflow(Incident incident, String notifiedBy) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades: incidentId={}",
                incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("severity", incident.getIncseverity());
            variables.put("notificationDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("notifiedBy", notifiedBy);

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-authority-notification-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para notificación a autoridades: {}",
                    incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para análisis de causa raíz (RCA)
     *
     * @param incident Incidente
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerRCAWorkflow(Incident incident) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para RCA: incidentId={}", incident.getIdxincident());

        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("incidentId", incident.getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", incident.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("rcaAnalysis", incident.getIncrca());
            variables.put("rcaDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-rca-analysis-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            return instance.getProcessInstanceId();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para RCA: {}", incident.getIdxincident(), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para cierre de incidente

    private String triggerIncidentClosureWorkflow(Incident incident) {

package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.CorrectiveActionRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.workflow.engine.service.ProcessRuntimeService;
import org.flowable.engine.runtime.ProcessInstance;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * BusinessService para Acciones Correctoras según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Gestiona acciones correctoras para resolver incidentes.
 * Rastrea efectividad y cierra incidentes cuando efectividad >= 0.80
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class CorrectiveActionService {

    @Autowired
    private CorrectiveActionRepository repository;

    @Autowired
    private IncidentService incidentService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;

    /**
     * Crea una acción correctora
     * 
     * @param incidentId ID del incidente asociado
     * @param description Descripción de la acción correctora
     * @param plannedDate Fecha planificada para completar la acción (opcional)
     * @return Acción correctora creada
     */
    public CorrectiveAction createCorrectiveAction(Long incidentId, String description, Timestamp plannedDate) {
        log.info("Creating corrective action for incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = incidentService.findById(incidentId);
        if (incident == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId);
        }

        Project project = incident.getProject();

        CorrectiveAction action = new CorrectiveAction();
        action.setIncident(incident);
        action.setProject(project);
        action.setCadescription(description);
        action.setCaplanneddate(plannedDate);
        action.setCastatus("PLANNED");
        action.setCacreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        action.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        action = repository.save(action);
        log.info("Corrective action created with ID: {}", action.getIdcorrectiveaction());

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para gestión de acción correctora
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerCorrectiveActionWorkflow(action);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Corrective action workflow BPMN launched: actionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching corrective action workflow for action: {}",
                    action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), e);
            // No fallar la creación de la acción si el workflow falla
        }

        return action;
    }

    /**
     * Rastrea efectividad de la acción
     * Si efectividad >= 0.80, cierra el incidente asociado
     */
    public void trackEffectiveness(Long actionId, BigDecimal effectiveness) {
        log.info("Tracking effectiveness for action: {} with value: {}", actionId, effectiveness);

        if (effectiveness.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0 ||
            effectiveness.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Effectiveness must be between 0.00 and 1.00");
        }

        CorrectiveAction action = repository.findById(actionId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Corrective action not found: " + actionId));

        action.setCaeffectiveness(effectiveness);

        repository.save(action);
        log.info("Effectiveness tracked for action: {}", actionId);

        // Si efectividad >= 0.80, cerrar incidente
        BigDecimal threshold = new BigDecimal("0.80");
        if (effectiveness.compareTo(threshold) >= 0) {
            log.info("Effectiveness {} >= {}, closing incident: {}",
                effectiveness, threshold, action.getIncident().getIdxincident());
            incidentService.closeIncident(action.getIncident().getIdxincident());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Actualiza estado de la acción
     */
    public void updateStatus(Long actionId, String status) {
        log.info("Updating status for action: {} to {}", actionId, status);

        CorrectiveAction action = repository.findById(actionId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Corrective action not found: " + actionId));

        action.setCastatus(status);

        if ("COMPLETED".equals(status) || "VERIFIED".equals(status)) {
            action.setCaactualdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }

        repository.save(action);
        log.info("Status updated for action: {}", actionId);
    }

    /**
     * Busca acciones con filtros
     */
    public List<CorrectiveAction> findByFilters(String status, Long incidentId, String search) {
        log.info("Finding corrective actions with filters - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);
        return repository.findByFilters(incidentId, status, search);
    }

    /**
     * Busca acción por ID
     */
    public CorrectiveAction findById(Long actionId) {
        return repository.findById(actionId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Corrective action not found: " + actionId));
    }

    /**
     * Cuenta acciones pendientes
     */
    public long countPendingActions() {
        return repository.countPendingActions();
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para gestión de acción correctora
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     * El workflow BPMN gestionará el proceso de ejecución, seguimiento y verificación de la acción correctora.
     *
     * @param action Acción correctora creada
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerCorrectiveActionWorkflow(CorrectiveAction action) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para acción correctora: actionId={}, incidentId={}",
                action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), action.getIncident().getIdxincident());

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("actionId", action.getIdcorrectiveaction());
            variables.put("incidentId", action.getIncident().getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", action.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("description", action.getCadescription());
            variables.put("status", action.getCastatus());
            variables.put("plannedDate", action.getCaplanneddate() != null ?
                    action.getCaplanneddate().toLocalDateTime().toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("createdAt", action.getCacreatedat() != null ?
                    action.getCacreatedat().toLocalDateTime().toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-corrective-action-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: actionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para acción correctora: {}", action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la creación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**

package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.CorrectiveActionRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.workflow.engine.service.ProcessRuntimeService;
import org.flowable.engine.runtime.ProcessInstance;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * BusinessService para Acciones Correctoras según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Gestiona acciones correctoras para resolver incidentes.
 * Rastrea efectividad y cierra incidentes cuando efectividad >= 0.80
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class CorrectiveActionService {

    @Autowired
    private CorrectiveActionRepository repository;

    @Autowired
    private IncidentService incidentService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;

    /**
     * Crea una acción correctora
     * 
     * @param incidentId ID del incidente asociado
     * @param description Descripción de la acción correctora
     * @param plannedDate Fecha planificada para completar la acción (opcional)
     * @return Acción correctora creada
     */
    public CorrectiveAction createCorrectiveAction(Long incidentId, String description, Timestamp plannedDate) {
        log.info("Creating corrective action for incident: {}", incidentId);

        Incident incident = incidentService.findById(incidentId);
        if (incident == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Incident not found: " + incidentId);
        }

        Project project = incident.getProject();

        CorrectiveAction action = new CorrectiveAction();
        action.setIncident(incident);
        action.setProject(project);
        action.setCadescription(description);
        action.setCaplanneddate(plannedDate);
        action.setCastatus("PLANNED");
        action.setCacreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        action.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        action = repository.save(action);
        log.info("Corrective action created with ID: {}", action.getIdcorrectiveaction());

        // Lanzar workflow BPMN para gestión de acción correctora
        try {
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerCorrectiveActionWorkflow(action);
            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Corrective action workflow BPMN launched: actionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error launching corrective action workflow for action: {}",
                    action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), e);
            // No fallar la creación de la acción si el workflow falla
        }

        return action;
    }

    /**
     * Rastrea efectividad de la acción
     * Si efectividad >= 0.80, cierra el incidente asociado
     */
    public void trackEffectiveness(Long actionId, BigDecimal effectiveness) {
        log.info("Tracking effectiveness for action: {} with value: {}", actionId, effectiveness);

        if (effectiveness.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0 ||
            effectiveness.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Effectiveness must be between 0.00 and 1.00");
        }

        CorrectiveAction action = repository.findById(actionId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Corrective action not found: " + actionId));

        action.setCaeffectiveness(effectiveness);

        repository.save(action);
        log.info("Effectiveness tracked for action: {}", actionId);

        // Si efectividad >= 0.80, cerrar incidente
        BigDecimal threshold = new BigDecimal("0.80");
        if (effectiveness.compareTo(threshold) >= 0) {
            log.info("Effectiveness {} >= {}, closing incident: {}",
                effectiveness, threshold, action.getIncident().getIdxincident());
            incidentService.closeIncident(action.getIncident().getIdxincident());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Actualiza estado de la acción
     */
    public void updateStatus(Long actionId, String status) {
        log.info("Updating status for action: {} to {}", actionId, status);

        CorrectiveAction action = repository.findById(actionId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Corrective action not found: " + actionId));

        action.setCastatus(status);

        if ("COMPLETED".equals(status) || "VERIFIED".equals(status)) {
            action.setCaactualdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }

        repository.save(action);
        log.info("Status updated for action: {}", actionId);
    }

    /**
     * Busca acciones con filtros
     */
    public List<CorrectiveAction> findByFilters(String status, Long incidentId, String search) {
        log.info("Finding corrective actions with filters - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);
        return repository.findByFilters(incidentId, status, search);
    }

    /**
     * Busca acción por ID
     */
    public CorrectiveAction findById(Long actionId) {
        return repository.findById(actionId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Corrective action not found: " + actionId));
    }

    /**
     * Cuenta acciones pendientes
     */
    public long countPendingActions() {
        return repository.countPendingActions();
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para gestión de acción correctora
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     * El workflow BPMN gestionará el proceso de ejecución, seguimiento y verificación de la acción correctora.
     *
     * @param action Acción correctora creada
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerCorrectiveActionWorkflow(CorrectiveAction action) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para acción correctora: actionId={}, incidentId={}",
                action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), action.getIncident().getIdxincident());

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("actionId", action.getIdcorrectiveaction());
            variables.put("incidentId", action.getIncident().getIdxincident());
            variables.put("projectId", action.getProject().getIdxproject());
            variables.put("description", action.getCadescription());
            variables.put("status", action.getCastatus());
            variables.put("plannedDate", action.getCaplanneddate() != null ?
                    action.getCaplanneddate().toLocalDateTime().toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("createdAt", action.getCacreatedat() != null ?
                    action.getCacreatedat().toLocalDateTime().toString() : LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-corrective-action-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: actionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para acción correctora: {}", action.getIdcorrectiveaction(), e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la creación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

}

            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

        // Obtener métricas actuales (mock - en producción vendría de sistema de métricas)
        Map<String, Object> currentMetrics = getCurrentMetrics(projectId);
        Map<String, Object> qualityMetrics = getQualityMetrics(projectId);

        // Comparar con baseline
        Map<String, Object> baselineMetrics = getBaselineMetrics(projectId);
        boolean driftDetected = detectDrift(currentMetrics, baselineMetrics);
        boolean anomaliesDetected = detectAnomalies(currentMetrics, baselineMetrics);

        // Crear registro de monitoreo
        PostMarketMonitoring monitoring = new PostMarketMonitoring();
        monitoring.setProject(project);
        monitoring.setPmmmonitoringdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        monitoring.setPmmperformancemetrics(convertToJson(currentMetrics));
        monitoring.setPmmqualitymetrics(convertToJson(qualityMetrics));
        monitoring.setPmmdriftdetected(driftDetected);
        monitoring.setPmmanomaliesdetected(anomaliesDetected);
        monitoring.setPmmcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        monitoring.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        monitoring = repository.save(monitoring);
        log.info("Monitoring record created with ID: {}", monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());

        // Si se detectan anomalías o drift, lanzar workflow BPMN
        if (anomaliesDetected || driftDetected) {
            log.warn("Anomalies or drift detected for project: {}", projectId);
            try {
                String workflowInstanceId = triggerMonitoringAlertWorkflow(projectId, monitoring, driftDetected, anomaliesDetected);
                if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                    log.info("Monitoring alert workflow BPMN launched: projectId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                            projectId, workflowInstanceId);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Error launching monitoring alert workflow for project: {}", projectId, e);
                // No fallar el monitoreo si el workflow falla
            }
        }

        return monitoring;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene historial de monitoreo
     */
    public List<PostMarketMonitoring> getMonitoringHistory(Long projectId, Timestamp from, Timestamp to) {
        log.info("Getting monitoring history for project: {} from {} to {}", projectId, from, to);
        return repository.findByProjectIdAndDateRange(projectId, from, to);
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene métricas del dashboard
     * 
     * @return Array con [systemsMonitored, activeIncidents, pendingActions, slaCompliance]
     */
    public Object[] getDashboardMetrics() {
        long systemsMonitored = repository.countDistinctProjects();
        long activeIncidents = incidentService != null ? incidentService.countActiveIncidents() : 0;
        long pendingActions = correctiveActionService != null ? correctiveActionService.countPendingActions() : 0;
        double slaCompliance = calculateSLACompliance();

        return new Object[]{systemsMonitored, activeIncidents, pendingActions, slaCompliance};
    }

     */
    public List<PostMarketMonitoring> getSystemsInProduction(Long projectId) {
        if (projectId != null) {
            return repository.findByProjectId(projectId);

        return repository.findAll().stream()
            .distinct()
            .toList();

        return Map.of(
            "accuracy", 0.95,
            "latency", 100,
            "throughput", 1000
        );
    }

    private boolean detectDrift(Map<String, Object> current, Map<String, Object> baseline) {
        // TODO: Implementar lógica de detección de drift
        double currentAccuracy = (Double) current.get("accuracy");
        double baselineAccuracy = (Double) baseline.get("accuracy");
        return Math.abs(currentAccuracy - baselineAccuracy) > 0.05;

        double currentLatency = (Double) current.get("latency");
        double baselineLatency = (Double) baseline.get("latency");

        return 0.92;
    }

    /**

     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     * El workflow BPMN gestionará el proceso de revisión y notificación de alertas de monitoreo.
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param monitoring Registro de monitoreo
     * @param driftDetected Si se detectó drift
     * @param anomaliesDetected Si se detectaron anomalías
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerMonitoringAlertWorkflow(Long projectId, PostMarketMonitoring monitoring,
                                                   boolean driftDetected, boolean anomaliesDetected) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para alerta de monitoreo: projectId={}, driftDetected={}, anomaliesDetected={}",
                projectId, driftDetected, anomaliesDetected);

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("monitoringId", monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());
            variables.put("monitoringDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("driftDetected", driftDetected);
            variables.put("anomaliesDetected", anomaliesDetected);
            variables.put("performanceMetrics", monitoring.getPmmperformancemetrics());
            variables.put("qualityMetrics", monitoring.getPmmqualitymetrics());
            variables.put("requiresInvestigation", anomaliesDetected || driftDetected);
            variables.put("alertLevel", anomaliesDetected ? "HIGH" : "MEDIUM");

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-monitoring-alert-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    projectId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para proyecto: {}", projectId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar el monitoreo si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private IncidentService incidentService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;

    /**
     * Clase interna para métricas del dashboard
     */
    public static class PMMMetrics {
        private final long systemsMonitored;
        private final long activeIncidents;
        private final long pendingActions;
        private final double slaCompliance;

        public PMMMetrics(long systemsMonitored, long activeIncidents, long pendingActions, double slaCompliance) {
            this.systemsMonitored = systemsMonitored;
            this.activeIncidents = activeIncidents;
            this.pendingActions = pendingActions;
            this.slaCompliance = slaCompliance;
        }

        public long getSystemsMonitored() { return systemsMonitored; }
        public long getActiveIncidents() { return activeIncidents; }
        public long getPendingActions() { return pendingActions; }
        public double getSlaCompliance() { return slaCompliance; }
    }
}

            log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    projectId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para proyecto: {}", projectId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar el monitoreo si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private IncidentService incidentService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;
}

package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.CorrectiveActionService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.IncidentService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.PostMarketMonitoringService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.PostMarketMonitoring;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para Post-Market Monitoring según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/dashboard - Dashboard de PMM
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Listar incidentes
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Reportar incidente
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents/{id}/notify-authority - Notificar autoridades
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Listar acciones correctoras
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Crear acción correctora
 * - PATCH /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions/{id} - Actualizar acción correctora
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/pmm")
@Tag(name = "Post-Market Monitoring", description = "Operaciones para monitoreo post-mercado, incidentes y acciones correctoras")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PMMController {

    private final PostMarketMonitoringService monitoringService;
    private final IncidentService incidentService;
    private final CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    // ========== Dashboard ==========

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener dashboard de PMM",
        description = "Retorna métricas principales y sistemas en producción"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del dashboard",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PMMDashboardDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PMMDashboardDto>> getDashboard(
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId) {
        log.info("Request to get PMM dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Object[] metricsArray = monitoringService.getDashboardMetrics();
                List<PostMarketMonitoring> systems = monitoringService.getSystemsInProduction(projectId);

                PMMMetricsDto metricsDto = new PMMMetricsDto(
                    ((Long) metricsArray[0]),
                    ((Long) metricsArray[1]),
                    ((Long) metricsArray[2]),
                    ((Double) metricsArray[3])
                );

                List<PMMSystemDto> systemsDto = systems.stream()
                    .map(this::toSystemDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return new PMMDashboardDto(metricsDto, systemsDto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting dashboard", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PMMDashboardDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Incidents ==========

    @GetMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar incidentes",
        description = "Retorna lista de incidentes con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de incidentes",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<IncidentDto>>> getIncidents(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String severity,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get incidents - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Incident> incidents = incidentService.findByFilters(severity, status, projectId, search);
                return incidents.stream()
                    .map(this::toIncidentDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting incidents", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<IncidentDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Reportar incidente",
        description = "Reporta un nuevo incidente. Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Incidente creado",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<IncidentDto>> reportIncident(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<ReportIncidentRequest> requestMono,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to report incident for project: {} with severity: {}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getSeverity()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                IncidentService.IncidentData data = new IncidentService.IncidentData();
                data.setSeverity(request.getSeverity());
                data.setDescription(request.getDescription());
                data.setImpact(request.getImpact());

                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        Incident incident = incidentService.reportIncident(
                            request.getProjectId(),
                            data,
                            username != null ? username : "system"
                        );
                        return toIncidentDto(incident);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error reporting incident", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents/{id}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Notificar autoridades",
        description = "Notifica manualmente a autoridades sobre un incidente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Autoridades notificadas"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to notify authority for incident: {} by {}", id, username);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                incidentService.notifyAuthority(id, username != null ? username : "system");
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Incident not found: {}", id);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>notFound().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error notifying authority", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Corrective Actions ==========

    @GetMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar acciones correctoras",
        description = "Retorna lista de acciones correctoras con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de acciones correctoras",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>> getCorrectiveActions(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long incidentId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get corrective actions - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<CorrectiveAction> actions = correctiveActionService.findByFilters(status, incidentId, search);
                return actions.stream()
                    .map(this::toCorrectiveActionDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting corrective actions", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear acción correctora",
        description = "Crea una nueva acción correctora para resolver un incidente"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora creada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> createCorrectiveAction(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to create corrective action for incident: {}",
                request.getIncidentId()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                CorrectiveActionService.CorrectiveActionData data =
                    new CorrectiveActionService.CorrectiveActionData();
                data.setDescription(request.getDescription());
                if (request.getPlannedDate() != null) {
                    data.setPlannedDate(Timestamp.valueOf(request.getPlannedDate()));
                }

                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.createCorrectiveAction(
                            request.getIncidentId(),
                            data
                        );
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PatchMapping("/corrective-actions/{id}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Actualizar acción correctora",
        description = "Actualiza estado o efectividad de una acción correctora"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora actualizada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Acción no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> updateCorrectiveAction(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<UpdateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to update corrective action: {} with status: {}, effectiveness: {}",
                id, request.getStatus(), request.getEffectiveness()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.updateStatus(id, request.getStatus());
                        }
                        if (request.getEffectiveness() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.trackEffectiveness(id, request.getEffectiveness());
                        }

                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.findById(id);
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/health")
    @Operation(summary = "Health check", description = "Endpoint de health check para el servicio PMM")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok("PMM service is running"));
    }

    // ========== DTO Mappers ==========

    private IncidentDto toIncidentDto(Incident incident) {
        IncidentDto dto = new IncidentDto();
        dto.setIdxincident(incident.getIdxincident());
        dto.setIduuid(incident.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxproject(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setIncseverity(incident.getIncseverity());
        dto.setIncdescription(incident.getIncdescription());
        if (incident.getIncincidentdate() != null) {
            dto.setIncincidentdate(incident.getIncincidentdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncauthoritynotified(incident.getIncauthoritynotified());
        if (incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat() != null) {
            dto.setIncauthoritynotifiedat(incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncusersnotified(incident.getIncusersnotified());
        dto.setIncrca(incident.getIncrca());
        dto.setIncstatus(incident.getIncstatus());
        if (incident.getInccreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setInccreatedat(incident.getInccreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private CorrectiveActionDto toCorrectiveActionDto(CorrectiveAction action) {
        CorrectiveActionDto dto = new CorrectiveActionDto();
        dto.setIdxcorrectiveaction(action.getIdcorrectiveaction());
        dto.setIduuid(action.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxincident(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIdxincident() : null);
        dto.setIncidentDescription(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIncdescription() : null);
        dto.setIdxproject(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setCadescription(action.getCadescription());
        if (action.getCaplanneddate() != null) {
            dto.setCaplanneddate(action.getCaplanneddate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (action.getCaactualdate() != null) {
            dto.setCaactualdate(action.getCaactualdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setCaeffectiveness(action.getCaeffectiveness());
        dto.setCastatus(action.getCastatus());
        if (action.getCacreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setCacreatedat(action.getCacreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private PMMSystemDto toSystemDto(PostMarketMonitoring monitoring) {
        PMMSystemDto dto = new PMMSystemDto();
        dto.setId(monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());
        dto.setProjectId(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getPrjname() : null);

        // Determinar estado basado en métricas
        if (monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("CRITICAL");
        } else if (monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("WARNING");
        } else {
            dto.setStatus("HEALTHY");
        }

        dto.setDriftDetected(monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected());
        dto.setAnomaliesDetected(monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected());
        if (monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate() != null) {
            dto.setLastCheck(monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate().toString());
        }

        // Parsear métricas desde JSON (simplificado)
        SystemMetricsDto metrics = new SystemMetricsDto();
        metrics.setAccuracy(0.95); // TODO: Parsear desde JSON
        metrics.setLatency(120L);
        metrics.setThroughput(1000L);
        dto.setMetrics(metrics);

        return dto;
    }
}

package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.controller;

/**
