```java
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents/{id}/notify-authority - Notificar autoridades

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/pmm")
@Tag(name = "Post-Market Monitoring", description = "Operaciones para monitoreo post-mercado, incidentes y acciones correctoras")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PMMController {

    private final IncidentService incidentService;
    private final CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    // ========== Dashboard ==========

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {

                List<PostMarketMonitoring> systems = monitoringService.getSystemsInProduction(projectId);

                PMMMetricsDto metricsDto = new PMMMetricsDto(

                return new PMMDashboardDto(metricsDto, systemsDto);

        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<IncidentDto>> reportIncident(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<ReportIncidentRequest> requestMono,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to report incident for project: {} with severity: {}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getSeverity()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {

                        Incident incident = incidentService.reportIncident(
                            request.getProjectId(),
                            request.getSeverity(),
                            request.getDescription(),
                            request.getImpact(),
                            username != null ? username : "system"
                        );
                        // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                        return toIncidentDto(incident);

                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);

            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error reporting incident", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents/{id}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Notificar autoridades",
        description = "Notifica manualmente a autoridades sobre un incidente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Autoridades notificadas"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to notify authority for incident: {} by {}", id, username);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                incidentService.notifyAuthority(id, username != null ? username : "system");
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Incident not found: {}", id);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>notFound().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error notifying authority", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Corrective Actions ==========

    @GetMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar acciones correctoras",
        description = "Retorna lista de acciones correctoras con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de acciones correctoras",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>> getCorrectiveActions(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long incidentId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get corrective actions - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<CorrectiveAction> actions = correctiveActionService.findByFilters(status, incidentId, search);
                return actions.stream()
                    .map(this::toCorrectiveActionDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting corrective actions", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });

    @PostMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear acción correctora",
        description = "Crea una nueva acción correctora para resolver un incidente"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora creada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> createCorrectiveAction(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to create corrective action for incident: {}",
                request.getIncidentId()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                CorrectiveActionService.CorrectiveActionData data =
                    new CorrectiveActionService.CorrectiveActionData();
                data.setDescription(request.getDescription());
                if (request.getPlannedDate() != null) {
                    data.setPlannedDate(Timestamp.valueOf(request.getPlannedDate()));
                }

                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.createCorrectiveAction(
                            request.getIncidentId(),
                            data
                        );
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PatchMapping("/corrective-actions/{id}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Actualizar acción correctora",
        description = "Actualiza estado o efectividad de una acción correctora"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora actualizada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Acción no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> updateCorrectiveAction(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<UpdateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to update corrective action: {} with status: {}, effectiveness: {}",
                id, request.getStatus(), request.getEffectiveness()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.updateStatus(id, request.getStatus());
                        }
                        if (request.getEffectiveness() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.trackEffectiveness(id, request.getEffectiveness());
                        }

                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.findById(id);
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {

    private IncidentDto toIncidentDto(Incident incident) {
        IncidentDto dto = new IncidentDto();
        dto.setIdxincident(incident.getIdxincident());
        dto.setIduuid(incident.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxproject(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setIncseverity(incident.getIncseverity());
        dto.setIncdescription(incident.getIncdescription());
        if (incident.getIncincidentdate() != null) {
            dto.setIncincidentdate(incident.getIncincidentdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncauthoritynotified(incident.getIncauthoritynotified());
        if (incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat() != null) {
            dto.setIncauthoritynotifiedat(incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncusersnotified(incident.getIncusersnotified());
        dto.setIncrca(incident.getIncrca());
        dto.setIncstatus(incident.getIncstatus());
        if (incident.getInccreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setInccreatedat(incident.getInccreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private CorrectiveActionDto toCorrectiveActionDto(CorrectiveAction action) {
        CorrectiveActionDto dto = new CorrectiveActionDto();
        dto.setIdxcorrectiveaction(action.getIdcorrectiveaction());
        dto.setIduuid(action.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxincident(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIdxincident() : null);
        dto.setIncidentDescription(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIncdescription() : null);
        dto.setIdxproject(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setCadescription(action.getCadescription());
        if (action.getCaplanneddate() != null) {
            dto.setCaplanneddate(action.getCaplanneddate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (action.getCaactualdate() != null) {
            dto.setCaactualdate(action.getCaactualdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setCaeffectiveness(action.getCaeffectiveness());
        dto.setCastatus(action.getCastatus());
        if (action.getCacreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setCacreatedat(action.getCacreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private PMMSystemDto toSystemDto(PostMarketMonitoring monitoring) {
        PMMSystemDto dto = new PMMSystemDto();
        dto.setId(monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());
        dto.setProjectId(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getPrjname() : null);

        // Determinar estado basado en métricas
        if (monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("CRITICAL");
        } else if (monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("WARNING");
        } else {
            dto.setStatus("HEALTHY");
        }

        dto.setDriftDetected(monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected());
        dto.setAnomaliesDetected(monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected());
        if (monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate() != null) {
            dto.setLastCheck(monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate().toString());
        }

        // Parsear métricas desde JSON (simplificado)
        SystemMetricsDto metrics = new SystemMetricsDto();
        metrics.setAccuracy(0.95); // TODO: Parsear desde JSON
        metrics.setLatency(120L);
        metrics.setThroughput(1000L);
        dto.setMetrics(metrics);

        return dto;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.CorrectiveActionService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.IncidentService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.PostMarketMonitoringService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.PostMarketMonitoring;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para Post-Market Monitoring según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/dashboard - Dashboard de PMM
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Listar incidentes
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Reportar incidente
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents/{id}/notify-authority - Notificar autoridades
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Listar acciones correctoras
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Crear acción correctora
 * - PATCH /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions/{id} - Actualizar acción correctora
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/pmm")
@Tag(name = "Post-Market Monitoring", description = "Operaciones para monitoreo post-mercado, incidentes y acciones correctoras")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PMMController {

    private final PostMarketMonitoringService monitoringService;
    private final IncidentService incidentService;
    private final CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    // ========== Dashboard ==========

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener dashboard de PMM",
        description = "Retorna métricas principales y sistemas en producción"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del dashboard",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PMMDashboardDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PMMDashboardDto>> getDashboard(
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId) {
        log.info("Request to get PMM dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Object[] metricsArray = monitoringService.getDashboardMetrics();
                List<PostMarketMonitoring> systems = monitoringService.getSystemsInProduction(projectId);

                PMMMetricsDto metricsDto = new PMMMetricsDto(
                    ((Long) metricsArray[0]),
                    ((Long) metricsArray[1]),
                    ((Long) metricsArray[2]),
                    ((Double) metricsArray[3])
                );

                List<PMMSystemDto> systemsDto = systems.stream()
                    .map(this::toSystemDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return new PMMDashboardDto(metricsDto, systemsDto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting dashboard", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PMMDashboardDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Incidents ==========

    @GetMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar incidentes",
        description = "Retorna lista de incidentes con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de incidentes",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<IncidentDto>>> getIncidents(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String severity,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get incidents - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Incident> incidents = incidentService.findByFilters(severity, status, projectId, search);
                return incidents.stream()
                    .map(this::toIncidentDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting incidents", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<IncidentDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Reportar incidente",
        description = "Reporta un nuevo incidente. Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Incidente creado",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<IncidentDto>> reportIncident(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<ReportIncidentRequest> requestMono,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to report incident for project: {} with severity: {}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getSeverity()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                        Incident incident = incidentService.reportIncident(
                            request.getProjectId(),
                            request.getSeverity(),
                            request.getDescription(),
                            request.getImpact(),
                            username != null ? username : "system"
                        );
                        // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                        return toIncidentDto(incident);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error reporting incident", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents/{id}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Notificar autoridades",
        description = "Notifica manualmente a autoridades sobre un incidente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Autoridades notificadas"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to notify authority for incident: {} by {}", id, username);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                incidentService.notifyAuthority(id, username != null ? username : "system");
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Incident not found: {}", id);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>notFound().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error notifying authority", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Corrective Actions ==========

    @GetMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar acciones correctoras",
        description = "Retorna lista de acciones correctoras con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",

        ),

    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>> getCorrectiveActions(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long incidentId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get corrective actions - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<CorrectiveAction> actions = correctiveActionService.findByFilters(status, incidentId, search);
                return actions.stream()
                    .map(this::toCorrectiveActionDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting corrective actions", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear acción correctora",
        description = "Crea una nueva acción correctora para resolver un incidente"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora creada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> createCorrectiveAction(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to create corrective action for incident: {}",
                request.getIncidentId()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                        Timestamp plannedDate = request.getPlannedDate() != null 
                            ? Timestamp.valueOf(request.getPlannedDate()) 
                            : null;
                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.createCorrectiveAction(
                            request.getIncidentId(),
                            request.getDescription(),
                            plannedDate
                        );
                        // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PatchMapping("/corrective-actions/{id}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Actualizar acción correctora",
        description = "Actualiza estado o efectividad de una acción correctora"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora actualizada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Acción no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> updateCorrectiveAction(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<UpdateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to update corrective action: {} with status: {}, effectiveness: {}",
                id, request.getStatus(), request.getEffectiveness()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.updateStatus(id, request.getStatus());
                        }
                        if (request.getEffectiveness() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.trackEffectiveness(id, request.getEffectiveness());
                        }

                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.findById(id);
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    private IncidentDto toIncidentDto(Incident incident) {
        IncidentDto dto = new IncidentDto();
        dto.setIdxincident(incident.getIdxincident());
        dto.setIduuid(incident.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxproject(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setIncseverity(incident.getIncseverity());
        dto.setIncdescription(incident.getIncdescription());
        if (incident.getIncincidentdate() != null) {
            dto.setIncincidentdate(incident.getIncincidentdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncauthoritynotified(incident.getIncauthoritynotified());
        if (incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat() != null) {
            dto.setIncauthoritynotifiedat(incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncusersnotified(incident.getIncusersnotified());
        dto.setIncrca(incident.getIncrca());
        dto.setIncstatus(incident.getIncstatus());
        if (incident.getInccreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setInccreatedat(incident.getInccreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private CorrectiveActionDto toCorrectiveActionDto(CorrectiveAction action) {
        CorrectiveActionDto dto = new CorrectiveActionDto();
        dto.setIdxcorrectiveaction(action.getIdcorrectiveaction());
        dto.setIduuid(action.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxincident(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIdxincident() : null);
        dto.setIncidentDescription(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIncdescription() : null);
        dto.setIdxproject(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setCadescription(action.getCadescription());
        if (action.getCaplanneddate() != null) {
            dto.setCaplanneddate(action.getCaplanneddate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (action.getCaactualdate() != null) {
            dto.setCaactualdate(action.getCaactualdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setCaeffectiveness(action.getCaeffectiveness());
        dto.setCastatus(action.getCastatus());
        if (action.getCacreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setCacreatedat(action.getCacreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private PMMSystemDto toSystemDto(PostMarketMonitoring monitoring) {
        PMMSystemDto dto = new PMMSystemDto();
        dto.setId(monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());
        dto.setProjectId(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getPrjname() : null);

        // Determinar estado basado en métricas
        if (monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("CRITICAL");
        } else if (monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("WARNING");
        } else {
            dto.setStatus("HEALTHY");
        }

        dto.setDriftDetected(monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected());
        dto.setAnomaliesDetected(monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected());
        if (monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate() != null) {
            dto.setLastCheck(monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate().toString());
        }

        // Parsear métricas desde JSON (simplificado)
        SystemMetricsDto metrics = new SystemMetricsDto();
        metrics.setAccuracy(0.95); // TODO: Parsear desde JSON
        metrics.setLatency(120L);
        metrics.setThroughput(1000L);
        dto.setMetrics(metrics);

        return dto;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

/**

 *

 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class PostMarketMonitoringService {

    @Autowired
    private PostMarketMonitoringRepository repository;

    @Autowired
    private ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    /**
     * Monitorea sistema en producción
     */
    public PostMarketMonitoring monitorSystem(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Monitoring system for project: {}", projectId);

        Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

        // Obtener métricas actuales (mock - en producción vendría de sistema de métricas)
        Map<String, Object> currentMetrics = getCurrentMetrics(projectId);
        Map<String, Object> qualityMetrics = getQualityMetrics(projectId);

        // Comparar con baseline
        Map<String, Object> baselineMetrics = getBaselineMetrics(projectId);
        boolean driftDetected = detectDrift(currentMetrics, baselineMetrics);
        boolean anomaliesDetected = detectAnomalies(currentMetrics, baselineMetrics);

        // Crear registro de monitoreo
        PostMarketMonitoring monitoring = new PostMarketMonitoring();
        monitoring.setProject(project);
        monitoring.setPmmmonitoringdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        monitoring.setPmmperformancemetrics(convertToJson(currentMetrics));
        monitoring.setPmmqualitymetrics(convertToJson(qualityMetrics));
        monitoring.setPmmdriftdetected(driftDetected);
        monitoring.setPmmanomaliesdetected(anomaliesDetected);
        monitoring.setPmmcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        monitoring.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        monitoring = repository.save(monitoring);
        log.info("Monitoring record created with ID: {}", monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());

        // Si se detectan anomalías o drift, lanzar workflow BPMN
        if (anomaliesDetected || driftDetected) {
            log.warn("Anomalies or drift detected for project: {}", projectId);
            try {
                String workflowInstanceId = triggerMonitoringAlertWorkflow(projectId, monitoring, driftDetected, anomaliesDetected);
                if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                    log.info("Monitoring alert workflow BPMN launched: projectId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                            projectId, workflowInstanceId);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Error launching monitoring alert workflow for project: {}", projectId, e);
                // No fallar el monitoreo si el workflow falla
            }
        }

        return monitoring;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene historial de monitoreo
     */
    public List<PostMarketMonitoring> getMonitoringHistory(Long projectId, Timestamp from, Timestamp to) {
        log.info("Getting monitoring history for project: {} from {} to {}", projectId, from, to);
        return repository.findByProjectIdAndDateRange(projectId, from, to);
    }

    /**

    public long getSystemsMonitored() {

    /**

    public long getActiveIncidents() {

    }

    public long getPendingActions() {

     */
    public double getSLACompliance() {
        return calculateSLACompliance();
    }

    /**

     */
    public List<PostMarketMonitoring> getSystemsInProduction(Long projectId) {
        if (projectId != null) {
            return repository.findByProjectId(projectId);
        }
        // Obtener último monitoreo de cada proyecto
        return repository.findAll().stream()
            .distinct()
            .toList();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // PRIVATE HELPER METHODS
    // ============================================================================

    private Map<String, Object> getCurrentMetrics(Long projectId) {
        // TODO: Integrar con sistema de métricas real
        // Por ahora retorna mock
        return Map.of(
            "accuracy", 0.95,
            "latency", 120,
            "throughput", 1000
        );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> getQualityMetrics(Long projectId) {

        return Map.of(
            "precision", 0.92,
            "recall", 0.88,
            "f1Score", 0.90
        );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> getBaselineMetrics(Long projectId) {
        // TODO: Obtener baseline del proyecto
        return Map.of(
            "accuracy", 0.95,
            "latency", 100,
            "throughput", 1000
        );
    }

    private boolean detectDrift(Map<String, Object> current, Map<String, Object> baseline) {
        // TODO: Implementar lógica de detección de drift
        double currentAccuracy = (Double) current.get("accuracy");
        double baselineAccuracy = (Double) baseline.get("accuracy");
        return Math.abs(currentAccuracy - baselineAccuracy) > 0.05;
    }

    private boolean detectAnomalies(Map<String, Object> current, Map<String, Object> baseline) {
        // TODO: Implementar lógica de detección de anomalías
        double currentLatency = (Double) current.get("latency");
        double baselineLatency = (Double) baseline.get("latency");
        return currentLatency > baselineLatency * 1.5;
    }

    private String convertToJson(Map<String, Object> map) {
        // TODO: Usar Jackson o Gson para convertir a JSON
        // Por ahora retorna string simple
        return map.toString();
    }

    private double calculateSLACompliance() {
        // TODO: Calcular cumplimiento SLA basado en métricas históricas
        return 0.92;
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para alerta de monitoreo (drift o anomalías detectadas)
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     * El workflow BPMN gestionará el proceso de revisión y notificación de alertas de monitoreo.
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param monitoring Registro de monitoreo
     * @param driftDetected Si se detectó drift
     * @param anomaliesDetected Si se detectaron anomalías
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerMonitoringAlertWorkflow(Long projectId, PostMarketMonitoring monitoring,
                                                   boolean driftDetected, boolean anomaliesDetected) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para alerta de monitoreo: projectId={}, driftDetected={}, anomaliesDetected={}",
                projectId, driftDetected, anomaliesDetected);

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("monitoringId", monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());
            variables.put("monitoringDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());
            variables.put("driftDetected", driftDetected);
            variables.put("anomaliesDetected", anomaliesDetected);
            variables.put("performanceMetrics", monitoring.getPmmperformancemetrics());
            variables.put("qualityMetrics", monitoring.getPmmqualitymetrics());
            variables.put("requiresInvestigation", anomaliesDetected || driftDetected);
            variables.put("alertLevel", anomaliesDetected ? "HIGH" : "MEDIUM");

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "pmm-monitoring-alert-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    projectId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para proyecto: {}", projectId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar el monitoreo si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private IncidentService incidentService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;
}
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.CorrectiveActionService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.IncidentService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.PostMarketMonitoringService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.PostMarketMonitoring;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para Post-Market Monitoring según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/dashboard - Dashboard de PMM
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Listar incidentes
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Reportar incidente
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents/{id}/notify-authority - Notificar autoridades
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Listar acciones correctoras
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Crear acción correctora
 * - PATCH /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions/{id} - Actualizar acción correctora
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/pmm")
@Tag(name = "Post-Market Monitoring", description = "Operaciones para monitoreo post-mercado, incidentes y acciones correctoras")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PMMController {

    private final PostMarketMonitoringService monitoringService;
    private final IncidentService incidentService;
    private final CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    // ========== Dashboard ==========

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener dashboard de PMM",
        description = "Retorna métricas principales y sistemas en producción"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del dashboard",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PMMDashboardDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PMMDashboardDto>> getDashboard(
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId) {
        log.info("Request to get PMM dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Servicio de negocio retorna valores primitivos, controlador construye DTO
                long systemsMonitored = monitoringService.getSystemsMonitored();
                long activeIncidents = monitoringService.getActiveIncidents();
                long pendingActions = monitoringService.getPendingActions();
                double slaCompliance = monitoringService.getSLACompliance();
                
                List<PostMarketMonitoring> systems = monitoringService.getSystemsInProduction(projectId);

                PMMMetricsDto metricsDto = new PMMMetricsDto(
                    systemsMonitored,
                    activeIncidents,
                    pendingActions,
                    slaCompliance
                );

                List<PMMSystemDto> systemsDto = systems.stream()
                    .map(this::toSystemDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return new PMMDashboardDto(metricsDto, systemsDto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting dashboard", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PMMDashboardDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Incidents ==========

    @GetMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar incidentes",
        description = "Retorna lista de incidentes con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de incidentes",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<IncidentDto>>> getIncidents(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String severity,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get incidents - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Incident> incidents = incidentService.findByFilters(severity, status, projectId, search);
                return incidents.stream()
                    .map(this::toIncidentDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting incidents", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<IncidentDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Reportar incidente",
        description = "Reporta un nuevo incidente. Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Incidente creado",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<IncidentDto>> reportIncident(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<ReportIncidentRequest> requestMono,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to report incident for project: {} with severity: {}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getSeverity()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                        Incident incident = incidentService.reportIncident(
                            request.getProjectId(),
                            request.getSeverity(),
                            request.getDescription(),
                            request.getImpact(),
                            username != null ? username : "system"
                        );
                        // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                        return toIncidentDto(incident);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error reporting incident", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents/{id}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Notificar autoridades",
        description = "Notifica manualmente a autoridades sobre un incidente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Autoridades notificadas"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to notify authority for incident: {} by {}", id, username);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                incidentService.notifyAuthority(id, username != null ? username : "system");
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Incident not found: {}", id);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>notFound().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error notifying authority", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Corrective Actions ==========

    @GetMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar acciones correctoras",
        description = "Retorna lista de acciones correctoras con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de acciones correctoras",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>> getCorrectiveActions(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long incidentId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get corrective actions - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<CorrectiveAction> actions = correctiveActionService.findByFilters(status, incidentId, search);
                return actions.stream()
                    .map(this::toCorrectiveActionDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting corrective actions", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear acción correctora",
        description = "Crea una nueva acción correctora para resolver un incidente"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora creada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> createCorrectiveAction(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to create corrective action for incident: {}",
                request.getIncidentId()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                        Timestamp plannedDate = request.getPlannedDate() != null 
                            ? Timestamp.valueOf(request.getPlannedDate()) 
                            : null;
                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.createCorrectiveAction(
                            request.getIncidentId(),
                            request.getDescription(),
                            plannedDate
                        );
                        // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PatchMapping("/corrective-actions/{id}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Actualizar acción correctora",
        description = "Actualiza estado o efectividad de una acción correctora"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora actualizada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Acción no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> updateCorrectiveAction(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<UpdateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to update corrective action: {} with status: {}, effectiveness: {}",
                id, request.getStatus(), request.getEffectiveness()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.updateStatus(id, request.getStatus());
                        }
                        if (request.getEffectiveness() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.trackEffectiveness(id, request.getEffectiveness());
                        }

                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.findById(id);
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/health")
    @Operation(summary = "Health check", description = "Endpoint de health check para el servicio PMM")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok("PMM service is running"));
    }

    // ========== DTO Mappers ==========

    private IncidentDto toIncidentDto(Incident incident) {
        IncidentDto dto = new IncidentDto();
        dto.setIdxincident(incident.getIdxincident());
        dto.setIduuid(incident.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxproject(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(incident.getProject() != null ? incident.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setIncseverity(incident.getIncseverity());
        dto.setIncdescription(incident.getIncdescription());
        if (incident.getIncincidentdate() != null) {
            dto.setIncincidentdate(incident.getIncincidentdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncauthoritynotified(incident.getIncauthoritynotified());
        if (incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat() != null) {
            dto.setIncauthoritynotifiedat(incident.getIncauthoritynotifiedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setIncusersnotified(incident.getIncusersnotified());
        dto.setIncrca(incident.getIncrca());
        dto.setIncstatus(incident.getIncstatus());
        if (incident.getInccreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setInccreatedat(incident.getInccreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private CorrectiveActionDto toCorrectiveActionDto(CorrectiveAction action) {
        CorrectiveActionDto dto = new CorrectiveActionDto();
        dto.setIdxcorrectiveaction(action.getIdcorrectiveaction());
        dto.setIduuid(action.getIduuid());
        dto.setIdxincident(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIdxincident() : null);
        dto.setIncidentDescription(action.getIncident() != null ? action.getIncident().getIncdescription() : null);
        dto.setIdxproject(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(action.getProject() != null ? action.getProject().getPrjname() : null);
        dto.setCadescription(action.getCadescription());
        if (action.getCaplanneddate() != null) {
            dto.setCaplanneddate(action.getCaplanneddate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (action.getCaactualdate() != null) {
            dto.setCaactualdate(action.getCaactualdate().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setCaeffectiveness(action.getCaeffectiveness());
        dto.setCastatus(action.getCastatus());
        if (action.getCacreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setCacreatedat(action.getCacreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private PMMSystemDto toSystemDto(PostMarketMonitoring monitoring) {
        PMMSystemDto dto = new PMMSystemDto();
        dto.setId(monitoring.getIdxpostmarketmonitoring());
        dto.setProjectId(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setProjectName(monitoring.getProject() != null ? monitoring.getProject().getPrjname() : null);

        // Determinar estado basado en métricas
        if (monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("CRITICAL");
        } else if (monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected() != null && monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected()) {
            dto.setStatus("WARNING");
        } else {
            dto.setStatus("HEALTHY");
        }

        dto.setDriftDetected(monitoring.getPmmdriftdetected());
        dto.setAnomaliesDetected(monitoring.getPmmanomaliesdetected());
        if (monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate() != null) {
            dto.setLastCheck(monitoring.getPmmmonitoringdate().toString());
        }

        // Parsear métricas desde JSON (simplificado)
        SystemMetricsDto metrics = new SystemMetricsDto();
        metrics.setAccuracy(0.95); // TODO: Parsear desde JSON
        metrics.setLatency(120L);
        metrics.setThroughput(1000L);
        dto.setMetrics(metrics);

        return dto;
    }
}
```

Verificando que no haya errores de compilación:


Correcciones aplicadas según la normativa de DTOs. Resumen de cambios:

## Cambios realizados según normativa de DTOs

### 1. Servicios de negocio — eliminadas clases internas

#### `PostMarketMonitoringService`
- Eliminada: clase interna `PMMMetrics`
- Cambiado: `getDashboardMetrics()` ahora retorna métodos individuales:
  - `getSystemsMonitored()` → `long`
  - `getActiveIncidents()` → `long`
  - `getPendingActions()` → `long`
  - `getSLACompliance()` → `double`
- Los servicios de negocio trabajan solo con entidades JPA y valores primitivos

#### `IncidentService`
- Eliminada: clase interna `IncidentData`
- Cambiado: `reportIncident()` ahora recibe parámetros individuales:
  ```java
  reportIncident(Long projectId, String severity, String description, String impact, String reportedBy)
  ```
- El servicio trabaja solo con entidades JPA

#### `CorrectiveActionService`
- Eliminada: clase interna `CorrectiveActionData`
- Cambiado: `createCorrectiveAction()` ahora recibe parámetros individuales:
  ```java
  createCorrectiveAction(Long incidentId, String description, Timestamp plannedDate)
  ```
- El servicio trabaja solo con entidades JPA

### 2. Controlador — conversión DTO ↔ Entidad

#### `PMMController`
- Conversión DTO → Entidad: el controlador convierte `ReportIncidentRequest` a parámetros antes de llamar al servicio
- Conversión Entidad → DTO: el controlador convierte entidades a DTOs antes de retornar respuestas
- Métodos de conversión: `toIncidentDto()`, `toCorrectiveActionDto()`, `toSystemDto()` están en el controlador
- Dashboard: el controlador construye `PMMMetricsDto` desde valores primitivos retornados por el servicio

### 3. Cumplimiento de normativa

- Los servicios de negocio no conocen DTOs
- Los servicios de negocio trabajan solo con entidades JPA y valores primitivos
- La conversión DTO ↔ Entidad se hace en el controlador
- Los controladores reciben y retornan DTOs
- Los DTOs están centralizados en `codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos`

### 4. Arquitectura resultante

```
Controller (PMMController)
  ↓ Recibe DTOs (ReportIncidentRequest, CreateCorrectiveActionRequest)
  ↓ Convierte DTO → Parámetros/Entidades
  ↓
Business Service (IncidentService, CorrectiveActionService, PostMarketMonitoringService)
  ↓ Trabaja con Entidades JPA y valores primitivos
  ↓ Retorna Entidades JPA
  ↓
Controller
  ↓ Convierte Entidades → DTOs
  ↓ Retorna DTOs (IncidentDto, CorrectiveActionDto, PMMDashboardDto)
```

Todos los cambios están aplicados y no hay errores de compilación. El código cumple con la normativa de DTOs documentada en `ARQUITECTURA_FRONTEND.md`.

El `PMMController` está correcto. El `GlobalExceptionHandler` retorna `Map<String, Object>`, lo cual viola la regla. Corrigiéndolo creando un DTO de error y actualizando el handler:


Creando un DTO de error y actualizando el `GlobalExceptionHandler` para cumplir la regla:


Creando un DTO genérico para errores de API y actualizando el `GlobalExceptionHandler`:


```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.api;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Data;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * DTO para respuestas de error de API
 * 
 * Según la normativa de arquitectura, SIEMPRE se debe retornar un DTO tipado,
 * nunca Map<String, Object> directamente.
 */
@Data
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Schema(description = "Respuesta de error de API")
public class ErrorResponseDto {

    @JsonProperty("error")
    @Schema(description = "Tipo de error", example = "Bad Request")
    private String error;

    @JsonProperty("message")
    @Schema(description = "Mensaje descriptivo del error", example = "Invalid request parameters")
    private String message;

    @JsonProperty("status")
    @Schema(description = "Código de estado HTTP", example = "400")
    private Integer status;

    @JsonProperty("errors")
    @Schema(description = "Lista de errores de validación (opcional)")
    private List<Object> errors;

    /**
     * Constructor para errores simples sin lista de errores de validación
     */
    public ErrorResponseDto(String error, String message, Integer status) {
        this.error = error;
        this.message = message;
        this.status = status;
        this.errors = null;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.exception;

import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.api.ErrorResponseDto;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.bind.support.WebExchangeBindException;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Manejador global de excepciones para el servicio PMM
 * 
 * ✅ SIEMPRE retorna DTOs tipados, nunca Map<String, Object>
 */
@RestControllerAdvice
@Slf4j
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleIllegalArgumentException(IllegalArgumentException ex) {
        log.warn("Illegal argument: {}", ex.getMessage());

        // ✅ Retornar DTO tipado en lugar de Map
        ErrorResponseDto errorResponse = new ErrorResponseDto(
            "Bad Request",
            ex.getMessage(),
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value()
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(errorResponse));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(WebExchangeBindException.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleValidationException(WebExchangeBindException ex) {
        log.warn("Validation error: {}", ex.getMessage());

        // ✅ Retornar DTO tipado en lugar de Map
        ErrorResponseDto errorResponse = new ErrorResponseDto(
            "Validation Failed",
            "Request validation failed",
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
            ex.getBindingResult().getAllErrors().stream()
                .map(error -> error.getDefaultMessage())
                .collect(Collectors.toList())
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(errorResponse));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleGenericException(Exception ex) {
        log.error("Unexpected error", ex);

        // ✅ Retornar DTO tipado en lugar de Map
        ErrorResponseDto errorResponse = new ErrorResponseDto(
            "Internal Server Error",
            "An unexpected error occurred",
            HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.value()
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(errorResponse));
    }
}
```
