```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.CorrectiveActionService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.IncidentService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.PostMarketMonitoringService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.PostMarketMonitoring;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para Post-Market Monitoring según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/dashboard - Dashboard de PMM
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Listar incidentes
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Reportar incidente
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents/{id}/notify-authority - Notificar autoridades
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Listar acciones correctoras
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Crear acción correctora
 * - PATCH /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions/{id} - Actualizar acción correctora
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/pmm")
@Tag(name = "Post-Market Monitoring", description = "Operaciones para monitoreo post-mercado, incidentes y acciones correctoras")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PMMController {

    private final PostMarketMonitoringService monitoringService;
    private final IncidentService incidentService;
    private final CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    // ========== Dashboard ==========

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener dashboard de PMM",
        description = "Retorna métricas principales y sistemas en producción"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del dashboard",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PMMDashboardDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PMMDashboardDto>> getDashboard(
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId) {
        log.info("Request to get PMM dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Servicio de negocio retorna valores primitivos, controlador construye DTO
                long systemsMonitored = monitoringService.getSystemsMonitored();
                long activeIncidents = monitoringService.getActiveIncidents();
                long pendingActions = monitoringService.getPendingActions();
                double slaCompliance = monitoringService.getSLACompliance();

                List<PostMarketMonitoring> systems = monitoringService.getSystemsInProduction(projectId);

                PMMMetricsDto metricsDto = new PMMMetricsDto(
                    systemsMonitored,
                    activeIncidents,
                    pendingActions,
                    slaCompliance
                );

                List<PMMSystemDto> systemsDto = systems.stream()
                    .map(this::toSystemDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return new PMMDashboardDto(metricsDto, systemsDto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting dashboard", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PMMDashboardDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Incidents ==========

    @GetMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar incidentes",
        description = "Retorna lista de incidentes con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de incidentes",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<IncidentDto>>> getIncidents(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String severity,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get incidents - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Incident> incidents = incidentService.findByFilters(severity, status, projectId, search);
                return incidents.stream()
                    .map(this::toIncidentDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting incidents", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<IncidentDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Reportar incidente",
        description = "Reporta un nuevo incidente. Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Incidente creado",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<IncidentDto>> reportIncident(
            @Valid @RequestBody ReportIncidentRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to report incident for project: {} with severity: {}",
            request.getProjectId(), request.getSeverity());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                Incident incident = incidentService.reportIncident(
                    request.getProjectId(),
                    request.getSeverity(),
                    request.getDescription(),
                    request.getImpact(),
                    username != null ? username : "system"
                );
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toIncidentDto(incident);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error reporting incident", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents/{id}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Notificar autoridades",
        description = "Notifica manualmente a autoridades sobre un incidente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Autoridades notificadas"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to notify authority for incident: {} by {}", id, username);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                incidentService.notifyAuthority(id, username != null ? username : "system");
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Incident not found: {}", id);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>notFound().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error notifying authority", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Corrective Actions ==========

    @GetMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar acciones correctoras",
        description = "Retorna lista de acciones correctoras con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de acciones correctoras",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>> getCorrectiveActions(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long incidentId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get corrective actions - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<CorrectiveAction> actions = correctiveActionService.findByFilters(status, incidentId, search);
                return actions.stream()
                    .map(this::toCorrectiveActionDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting corrective actions", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear acción correctora",
        description = "Crea una nueva acción correctora para resolver un incidente"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora creada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> createCorrectiveAction(
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateCorrectiveActionRequest request) {
        log.info("Request to create corrective action for incident: {}",
            request.getIncidentId());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                Timestamp plannedDate = request.getPlannedDate() != null
                    ? Timestamp.valueOf(request.getPlannedDate())
                    : null;
                CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.createCorrectiveAction(
                    request.getIncidentId(),
                    request.getDescription(),
                    plannedDate
                );
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PatchMapping("/corrective-actions/{id}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Actualizar acción correctora",
        description = "Actualiza estado o efectividad de una acción correctora"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora actualizada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Acción no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> updateCorrectiveAction(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<UpdateCorrectiveActionRequest> requestMono) {

        return requestMono
            .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Request to update corrective action: {} with status: {}, effectiveness: {}",
                id, request.getStatus(), request.getEffectiveness()))
            .flatMap(request -> {
                return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.updateStatus(id, request.getStatus());
                        }
                        if (request.getEffectiveness() != null) {
                            correctiveActionService.trackEffectiveness(id, request.getEffectiveness());
                        }

                        CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.findById(id);
                        return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
                    .map(ResponseEntity::ok);
            })
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating corrective action", error);
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.pmm.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.CorrectiveActionService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.IncidentService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.PostMarketMonitoringService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.CorrectiveAction;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.Incident;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.PostMarketMonitoring;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para Post-Market Monitoring según EU AI Act Art. 20 y 72
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/dashboard - Dashboard de PMM
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Listar incidentes
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents - Reportar incidente
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/incidents/{id}/notify-authority - Notificar autoridades
 * - GET /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Listar acciones correctoras
 * - POST /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions - Crear acción correctora
 * - PATCH /api/v1/pmm/corrective-actions/{id} - Actualizar acción correctora
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/pmm")
@Tag(name = "Post-Market Monitoring", description = "Operaciones para monitoreo post-mercado, incidentes y acciones correctoras")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PMMController {

    private final PostMarketMonitoringService monitoringService;
    private final IncidentService incidentService;
    private final CorrectiveActionService correctiveActionService;

    // ========== Dashboard ==========

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener dashboard de PMM",
        description = "Retorna métricas principales y sistemas en producción"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del dashboard",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PMMDashboardDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PMMDashboardDto>> getDashboard(
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId) {
        log.info("Request to get PMM dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Servicio de negocio retorna valores primitivos, controlador construye DTO
                long systemsMonitored = monitoringService.getSystemsMonitored();
                long activeIncidents = monitoringService.getActiveIncidents();
                long pendingActions = monitoringService.getPendingActions();
                double slaCompliance = monitoringService.getSLACompliance();

                List<PostMarketMonitoring> systems = monitoringService.getSystemsInProduction(projectId);

                PMMMetricsDto metricsDto = new PMMMetricsDto(
                    systemsMonitored,
                    activeIncidents,
                    pendingActions,
                    slaCompliance
                );

                List<PMMSystemDto> systemsDto = systems.stream()
                    .map(this::toSystemDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return new PMMDashboardDto(metricsDto, systemsDto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting dashboard", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PMMDashboardDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Incidents ==========

    @GetMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar incidentes",
        description = "Retorna lista de incidentes con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de incidentes",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<IncidentDto>>> getIncidents(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String severity,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get incidents - severity: {}, status: {}, projectId: {}, search: {}",
            severity, status, projectId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Incident> incidents = incidentService.findByFilters(severity, status, projectId, search);
                return incidents.stream()
                    .map(this::toIncidentDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting incidents", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<IncidentDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Reportar incidente",
        description = "Reporta un nuevo incidente. Si severidad >= HIGH, notifica autoridades automáticamente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Incidente creado",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = IncidentDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<IncidentDto>> reportIncident(
            @Valid @RequestBody ReportIncidentRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to report incident for project: {} with severity: {}",
            request.getProjectId(), request.getSeverity());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                Incident incident = incidentService.reportIncident(
                    request.getProjectId(),
                    request.getSeverity(),
                    request.getDescription(),
                    request.getImpact(),
                    username != null ? username : "system"
                );
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toIncidentDto(incident);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error reporting incident", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<IncidentDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/incidents/{id}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Notificar autoridades",
        description = "Notifica manualmente a autoridades sobre un incidente (Art. 20.1)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Autoridades notificadas"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal String username) {
        log.info("Request to notify authority for incident: {} by {}", id, username);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                incidentService.notifyAuthority(id, username != null ? username : "system");
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Incident not found: {}", id);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>notFound().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error notifying authority", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<Void>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ========== Corrective Actions ==========

    @GetMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar acciones correctoras",
        description = "Retorna lista de acciones correctoras con filtros opcionales"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de acciones correctoras",

    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>> getCorrectiveActions(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long incidentId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        log.info("Request to get corrective actions - status: {}, incidentId: {}, search: {}",
            status, incidentId, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<CorrectiveAction> actions = correctiveActionService.findByFilters(status, incidentId, search);
                return actions.stream()
                    .map(this::toCorrectiveActionDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting corrective actions", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<List<CorrectiveActionDto>>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/corrective-actions")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear acción correctora",
        description = "Crea una nueva acción correctora para resolver un incidente"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora creada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Incidente no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> createCorrectiveAction(
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateCorrectiveActionRequest request) {
        log.info("Request to create corrective action for incident: {}",
            request.getIncidentId());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a parámetros para servicio de negocio
                Timestamp plannedDate = request.getPlannedDate() != null
                    ? Timestamp.valueOf(request.getPlannedDate())
                    : null;
                CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.createCorrectiveAction(
                    request.getIncidentId(),
                    request.getDescription(),
                    plannedDate
                );
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PatchMapping("/corrective-actions/{id}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Actualizar acción correctora",
        description = "Actualiza estado o efectividad de una acción correctora"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Acción correctora actualizada",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = CorrectiveActionDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Acción no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CorrectiveActionDto>> updateCorrectiveAction(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody UpdateCorrectiveActionRequest request) {
        log.info("Request to update corrective action: {} with status: {}, effectiveness: {}",
            id, request.getStatus(), request.getEffectiveness());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                if (request.getStatus() != null) {
                    correctiveActionService.updateStatus(id, request.getStatus());
                }
                if (request.getEffectiveness() != null) {
                    correctiveActionService.trackEffectiveness(id, request.getEffectiveness());
                }

                CorrectiveAction action = correctiveActionService.findById(id);
                return toCorrectiveActionDto(action);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, error -> {
                log.warn("Invalid request: {}", error.getMessage());
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>badRequest().build());
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating corrective action", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<CorrectiveActionDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/health")
    @Operation(summary = "Health check", description = "Endpoint de health check para el servicio PMM")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
```

### Resumen de cumplimiento

- Los controladores reciben DTOs en request bodies
- Los controladores retornan DTOs en las respuestas
- Los manejadores de excepciones retornan DTOs tipados
- No se retornan `Map<String, Object>` directamente
- Todos los DTOs están centralizados en `codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos`

```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.bind.support.WebExchangeBindException;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Manejador global de excepciones para el servicio PMM
 * 
 * ✅ SIEMPRE retorna DTOs tipados, nunca Map<String, Object>
 */
@RestControllerAdvice
@Slf4j
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleIllegalArgumentException(IllegalArgumentException ex) {
        log.warn("Illegal argument: {}", ex.getMessage());

        // ✅ Retornar DTO tipado en lugar de Map (usando el DTO existente de core)
        ErrorResponseDto errorResponse = ErrorResponseDto.of(
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
            "Bad Request",
            ex.getMessage(),
            null // path no disponible en este contexto
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(errorResponse));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(WebExchangeBindException.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleValidationException(WebExchangeBindException ex) {
        log.warn("Validation error: {}", ex.getMessage());

        // ✅ Retornar DTO tipado en lugar de Map
        String validationMessage = ex.getBindingResult().getAllErrors().stream()
            .map(error -> error.getDefaultMessage())
            .reduce((msg1, msg2) -> msg1 + "; " + msg2)
            .orElse("Request validation failed");

        ErrorResponseDto errorResponse = ErrorResponseDto.of(
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
            "Validation Failed",
            validationMessage,
            null // path no disponible en este contexto
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(errorResponse));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleGenericException(Exception ex) {
        log.error("Unexpected error", ex);

        // ✅ Retornar DTO tipado en lugar de Map
        ErrorResponseDto errorResponse = ErrorResponseDto.of(
            HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.value(),
            "Internal Server Error",
            "An unexpected error occurred",
            null // path no disponible en este contexto
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(errorResponse));
    }
}
```

Corregido el problema: se había creado un DTO duplicado cuando ya existía uno en `core`.

## Cambios realizados

1. Eliminado el DTO duplicado: `api/ErrorResponseDto.java`
2. Actualizado `GlobalExceptionHandler` para usar el DTO existente: `core/ErrorResponseDto.java`

El `GlobalExceptionHandler` ahora usa `ErrorResponseDto` de `core`, que ya estaba en el proyecto. Esto debería resolver el reinicio del servidor.

El código ahora:
- Usa el DTO existente de `core`
- Retorna DTOs tipados en lugar de Maps
- Cumple con la normativa de arquitectura

El servidor debería iniciar correctamente. Si persiste el problema, revisa los logs de Spring Boot para ver el error específico.

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";

    try {
```

```typescriptreact
      // Obtener projectId de la URL o contexto

      const response = await fetch(`/api/governance/compliance/qms?projectId=${projectId}`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to load QMS data");
      }

      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setData(result.data);
      } else {
        throw new Error(result.error || "Failed to load QMS data");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading QMS data:", error);

      setData(mockQmsData);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 0.85) return "text-green-600";

            </div>
            <div className="text-center">
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.qms.status", "Estado")}</div>
              <div className="mt-1">{getComplianceStatusBadge(data.complianceStatus)}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Métricas Principales */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <MetricCard
            title={t("governance.qms.totalModules", "Total Módulos")}
            value={totalModules}
            description={t("governance.qms.modulesDescription", "13 módulos QMS")}
            icon={<ClipboardCheck className="w-5 h-5" />}
            color="blue"
          />
          <MetricCard
            title={t("governance.qms.compliantModules", "Módulos Cumpliendo")}
            value={compliantModules}
            description={`${((compliantModules / totalModules) * 100).toFixed(0)}% ${t("governance.qms.compliance", "cumplimiento")}`}
            icon={<CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5" />}
            color="green"
          />
          <MetricCard
            title={t("governance.qms.gapsDetected", "Gaps Detectados")}
            value={data.gaps.length}
            description={t("governance.qms.gapsDescription", "Requieren atención")}
            icon={<AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />}
            color="red"
          />
          <MetricCard
            title={t("governance.qms.overallScore", "Score Overall")}
            value={`${(data.overallScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
            description={t("governance.qms.scoreDescription", "Promedio de módulos")}
            icon={<TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />}
            color="purple"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Gráficos */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <BarChart
            data={data.modules.map((m) => ({
              label: m.displayName,
              value: m.score * 100,
              color: m.score >= 0.85 ? "#10b981" : m.score >= 0.70 ? "#f59e0b" : "#ef4444",
            }))}
            title={t("governance.qms.scoresByModule", "Scores por Módulo")}
            description={t("governance.qms.scoresDescription", "Distribución de scores de los 13 módulos QMS")}
            height={400}
            showValues={true}
          />
          {data.historicalScores && data.historicalScores.length > 0 && (
            <LineChartComponent
              data={data.historicalScores.map((h) => ({
                label: new Date(h.date).toLocaleDateString("es-ES", { month: "short", day: "numeric" }),
                value: h.score * 100,
                color: "#6366f1",
              }))}
              title={t("governance.qms.scoreEvolution", "Evolución del Score")}
              description={t("governance.qms.evolutionDescription", "Tendencia del score overall en el tiempo")}
              height={200}
            />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Scores por Módulo */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5" />
              {t("governance.qms.modules", "Módulos QMS")} ({totalModules} {t("governance.qms.modulesTotal", "módulos")})
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {data.modules.map((module) => (
                <div key={module.code} className="p-4 border rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm bg-background/40 hover:bg-background/60 transition-colors">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono">{module.code}</Badge>
                      <span className="font-semibold">{module.displayName}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                      <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${getScoreColor(module.score)}`}>
                        {(module.score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                      </div>
                      {module.score >= 0.80 ? (
                        <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-green-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-600" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-3 mb-2">
                    <div
                      className={`h-3 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${getScoreBgColor(module.score)}`}
                      style={{ width: `${module.score * 100}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span>{t("governance.qms.threshold", "Umbral")}: {(module.threshold * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                    <span>
                      {module.score >= module.threshold
                        ? t("governance.qms.compliant", "Cumple")
                        : t("governance.qms.nonCompliant", "No Cumple")}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {module.gaps.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t space-y-2">
                      {module.gaps.map((gap, idx) => (
                        <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                          {getSeverityBadge(gap.severity)}
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground flex-1">{gap.description}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Gaps y Plan de Mejora */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
                {t("governance.qms.gaps", "Gaps Detectados")} ({data.gaps.length})
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {data.gaps.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-2 text-green-500" />
                    <p>{t("governance.qms.noGaps", "No se detectaron gaps. Todos los módulos cumplen con el umbral.")}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  data.gaps.map((gap, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="p-4 border rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm bg-background/40 hover:bg-background/60 transition-colors">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <Badge variant="outline">{t("governance.qms.module", "Módulo")}: {gap.module}</Badge>
                        {getSeverityBadge(gap.severity)}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm mb-2">{gap.description}</div>
                      {gap.currentScore !== undefined && gap.targetScore !== undefined && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                          <span>{t("governance.qms.currentScore", "Score Actual")}: {(gap.currentScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                          <span>{t("governance.qms.targetScore", "Score Objetivo")}: {(gap.targetScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                          {gap.gap !== undefined && (
                            <span className="text-red-500 font-semibold">
                              {t("governance.qms.gap", "Gap")}: {(gap.gap * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {gap.recommendedActions && gap.recommendedActions.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t">
                          <div className="text-xs font-semibold mb-2">{t("governance.qms.recommendedActions", "Acciones Recomendadas")}:</div>
                          <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {gap.recommendedActions.map((action, actionIdx) => (
                              <li key={actionIdx}>{action}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
                {t("governance.qms.improvementPlan", "Plan de Mejora")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {data.improvementPlan.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                    <p>{t("governance.qms.noImprovements", "No hay acciones de mejora planificadas.")}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  data.improvementPlan.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="p-4 border rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm bg-background/40 hover:bg-background/60 transition-colors">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {getSeverityBadge(item.priority)}
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">{item.module}</Badge>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("governance.qms.deadline", "Plazo")}: {new Date(item.deadline).toLocaleDateString("es-ES")}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm font-medium">{item.action}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Acciones */}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline">{t("common.export", "Exportar")}</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                setLoading(true);
                const projectId = data?.projectId || 1;
                const response = await fetch("/api/governance/compliance/qms", {
                  method: "POST",
                  headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  },
                  body: JSON.stringify({ projectId, action: "calculate" }),
                });

                if (response.ok) {
                  const result = await response.json();
                  if (result.success) {
                    setData(result.data);
                  }
                }
              } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error calculating QMS score:", error);
              } finally {
                setLoading(false);
              }
            }}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.update", "Actualizar")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Network,
  Download,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Link2,
  FileText,
  ArrowLeft,
  Shield,
  Activity,
  Users,
  Database,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  mockEntityTraceability,
  mockProjectTraceability,
  mockAgentTraceability,
  type EntityTraceability,
  type IntegrityVerification,
} from "../../../../data/mockTraceability";

export default function EntityTraceabilityPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();
  const entityType = params?.entityType as string;
  const entityId = params?.id as string;

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [data, setData] = useState<EntityTraceability | null>(null);
  const [integrityVerification, setIntegrityVerification] = useState<IntegrityVerification | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [entityType, entityId]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));

      // Simular carga de datos según el tipo de entidad
      let traceabilityData: EntityTraceability | null = null;
      const id = parseInt(entityId || "0");

      switch (entityType?.toUpperCase()) {
        case "MODEL":
          traceabilityData = { ...mockEntityTraceability, entityId: id };
          break;
        case "PROJECT":
          traceabilityData = { ...mockProjectTraceability, entityId: id };
          break;
        case "AGENT":
          traceabilityData = { ...mockAgentTraceability, entityId: id };
          break;
        default:
          traceabilityData = { ...mockEntityTraceability, entityId: id };
      }

      setData(traceabilityData);
      setIntegrityVerification(traceabilityData.traceability.integrityVerification);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading entity traceability:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportEvidence = (format: "JSON" | "PDF") => {
    // TODO: Implementar exportación real
    console.log(`Exporting evidence as ${format} for ${entityType} ${entityId}`);
    alert(`Exportando evidencias como ${format}...`);
  };

  const getIntegrityStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "INTEGRITY_OK":
        return "bg-green-500";
      case "INTEGRITY_WARNING":
        return "bg-yellow-500";
      case "INTEGRITY_ERROR":
        return "bg-red-500";
      default:
        return "bg-gray-500";
    }
  };

  const getEntityIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type?.toUpperCase()) {
      case "MODEL":
        return <Activity className="w-6 h-6 text-pink-500" />;
      case "PROJECT":
        return <Database className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" />;
      case "AGENT":
        return <Users className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-500" />;
      default:
        return <Network className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-500" />;
    }
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-pink-500"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Partículas flotantes */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-pink-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-300" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header con botón de regreso */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push("/governance/compliance/traceability")}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Volver
          </Button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {getEntityIcon(entityType)}
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-pink-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                {data.entityName}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t(`compliance.traceability.entityTypes.${entityType}`, entityType)} #{data.entityId}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Información de la Entidad */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
              {t("compliance.traceability.entityInformation", "Entity Information")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("compliance.traceability.entityType", "Entity Type")}
                </p>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-base">
                  {t(`compliance.traceability.entityTypes.${data.entityType}`, data.entityType)}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("compliance.traceability.entityId", "Entity ID")}
                </p>
                <p className="text-lg font-semibold">#{data.entityId}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("compliance.traceability.entityName", "Entity Name")}
                </p>
                <p className="text-lg font-semibold">{data.entityName}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Verificación de Integridad */}
        {integrityVerification && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.integrityVerification", "Integrity Verification")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    {t("compliance.traceability.integrityScore", "Integrity Score")}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="text-3xl font-bold">
                      {(integrityVerification.score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                    </div>
                    <Badge className={getIntegrityStatusColor(integrityVerification.status)}>
                      {t(`compliance.traceability.integrityStatus.${integrityVerification.status}`, integrityVerification.status)}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    {t("compliance.traceability.verifiedLogs", "Verified Logs")}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {integrityVerification.verifiedLogs}/{integrityVerification.totalLogs}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    {t("compliance.traceability.totalLogs", "Total Logs")}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{integrityVerification.totalLogs}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => handleExportEvidence("JSON")}
                    className="w-full"
                  >
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    {t("compliance.traceability.exportJSON", "Export JSON")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {integrityVerification.issues && integrityVerification.issues.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-4 p-4 bg-yellow-500/10 border border-yellow-500/20 rounded-lg">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
                    <p className="font-semibold">Problemas de Integridad Detectados</p>
                  </div>
                  <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1">
                    {integrityVerification.issues.map((issue, idx) => (
                      <li key={idx} className="text-sm">{issue}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        )}

        {/* Trazabilidad Completa */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Link2 className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
              {t("compliance.traceability.completeTraceability", "Complete Traceability")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody className="space-y-6">
            {/* Logs Inmutables */}
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.immutableLogs", "Immutable Logs")}
              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {data.traceability.logs.map((log) => (
                  <div
                    key={log.id}
                    className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Badge variant="outline">{log.type}</Badge>
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                        {log.integrityVerified ? (
                          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />
                        ) : (
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm mb-2">{log.description}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <span>{log.userId}</span>
                      <span>Hash: {log.hash.substring(0, 20)}...</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Decisiones HITL */}
            {data.traceability.decisions.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                  {t("compliance.traceability.hitlDecisions", "HITL Decisions")}
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {data.traceability.decisions.map((decision) => (
                    <div
                      key={decision.id}
                      className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline">{decision.type}</Badge>
                          <Badge
                            className={
                              decision.decision === "APPROVED"
                                ? "bg-green-500"
                                : decision.decision === "REJECTED"
                                ? "bg-red-500"
                                : "bg-yellow-500"
                            }
                          >
                            {decision.decision}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {new Date(decision.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-sm mb-2">{decision.userId}</p>
                      {decision.notes && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{decision.notes}</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Outputs Generados */}
            {data.traceability.outputs.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                  {t("compliance.traceability.outputsGenerated", "Generated Outputs")}
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {data.traceability.outputs.map((output) => (
                    <div
                      key={output.id}
                      className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <Badge variant="outline">Output #{output.id}</Badge>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Confidence: {(output.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(output.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-2">
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Input:</p>
                          <p className="text-sm font-mono bg-background/50 p-2 rounded">
                            {output.input.substring(0, 100)}...
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Output:</p>
                          <p className="text-sm font-mono bg-background/50 p-2 rounded">
                            {output.output}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Entidades Relacionadas */}
        {data.relatedEntities.length > 0 && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Network className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.relationships", "Relationships")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {data.relatedEntities.map((entity, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/traceability/${entity.type}/${entity.id}`)}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <Badge variant="outline">{entity.type}</Badge>
                      <Badge variant="secondary">
                        {t(`compliance.traceability.relationships.${entity.relationship}`, entity.relationship)}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-semibold mb-1">{entity.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">ID: #{entity.id}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        )}

        {/* Acciones de Exportación */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Download className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
              {t("compliance.traceability.exportEvidence", "Export Evidence")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => handleExportEvidence("JSON")}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.exportJSON", "Export JSON")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => handleExportEvidence("PDF")}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.exportPDF", "Export PDF")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Network,
  Download,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Link2,
  FileText,
  ArrowLeft,
  Shield,
  Activity,
  Users,
  Database,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  mockEntityTraceability,
  mockProjectTraceability,
  mockAgentTraceability,
  type EntityTraceability,
  type IntegrityVerification,
} from "../../../../data/mockTraceability";

export default function EntityTraceabilityPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();
  const entityType = params?.entityType as string;
  const entityId = params?.id as string;

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [data, setData] = useState<EntityTraceability | null>(null);
  const [integrityVerification, setIntegrityVerification] = useState<IntegrityVerification | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [entityType, entityId]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));

      // Simular carga de datos según el tipo de entidad
      let traceabilityData: EntityTraceability | null = null;
      const id = parseInt(entityId || "0");

      switch (entityType?.toUpperCase()) {
        case "MODEL":
          traceabilityData = { ...mockEntityTraceability, entityId: id };
          break;
        case "PROJECT":
          traceabilityData = { ...mockProjectTraceability, entityId: id };
          break;
        case "AGENT":
          traceabilityData = { ...mockAgentTraceability, entityId: id };
          break;
        default:
          traceabilityData = { ...mockEntityTraceability, entityId: id };
      }

      setData(traceabilityData);
      setIntegrityVerification(traceabilityData.traceability.integrityVerification);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading entity traceability:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportEvidence = (format: "JSON" | "PDF") => {
    // TODO: Implementar exportación real
    console.log(`Exporting evidence as ${format} for ${entityType} ${entityId}`);
    alert(`Exportando evidencias como ${format}...`);
  };

  const getIntegrityStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "INTEGRITY_OK":
        return "bg-green-500";
      case "INTEGRITY_WARNING":
        return "bg-yellow-500";
      case "INTEGRITY_ERROR":
        return "bg-red-500";
      default:
        return "bg-gray-500";
    }
  };

  const getEntityIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type?.toUpperCase()) {
      case "MODEL":
        return <Activity className="w-6 h-6 text-pink-500" />;
      case "PROJECT":
        return <Database className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" />;
      case "AGENT":
        return <Users className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-500" />;
      default:
        return <Network className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-500" />;
    }
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-pink-500"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">

      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-pink-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-300" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                  {t("compliance.traceability.entityName", "Entity Name")}
                </p>
                <p className="text-lg font-semibold">{data.entityName}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Verificación de Integridad */}
        {integrityVerification && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>

                <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />

            <CardBody>

                  </div>
                  <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1">

                      <li key={idx} className="text-sm">{issue}</li>

        {/* Trazabilidad Completa */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">

          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody className="space-y-6">
            {/* Logs Inmutables */}
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />

              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {data.traceability.logs.map((log) => (
                  <div
                    key={log.id}

                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

            </div>

            {/* Decisiones HITL */}
            {data.traceability.decisions.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">

                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {data.traceability.decisions.map((decision) => (
                    <div
                      key={decision.id}
                      className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline">{decision.type}</Badge>
                          <Badge
                            className={
                              decision.decision === "APPROVED"
                                ? "bg-green-500"
                                : decision.decision === "REJECTED"
                                ? "bg-red-500"
                                : "bg-yellow-500"
                            }
                          >
                            {decision.decision}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {new Date(decision.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-sm mb-2">{decision.userId}</p>
                      {decision.notes && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{decision.notes}</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Outputs Generados */}
            {data.traceability.outputs.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                  {t("compliance.traceability.outputsGenerated", "Generated Outputs")}
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {data.traceability.outputs.map((output) => (
                    <div
                      key={output.id}
                      className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <Badge variant="outline">Output #{output.id}</Badge>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Confidence: {(output.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(output.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-2">
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Input:</p>
                          <p className="text-sm font-mono bg-background/50 p-2 rounded">
                            {output.input.substring(0, 100)}...
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Output:</p>
                          <p className="text-sm font-mono bg-background/50 p-2 rounded">
                            {output.output}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Entidades Relacionadas */}
        {data.relatedEntities.length > 0 && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Network className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.relationships", "Relationships")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {data.relatedEntities.map((entity, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className="p-4 border rounded-lg hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/compliance/traceability/${entity.type}/${entity.id}`)}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <Badge variant="outline">{entity.type}</Badge>
                      <Badge variant="secondary">
                        {t(`compliance.traceability.relationships.${entity.relationship}`, entity.relationship)}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-semibold mb-1">{entity.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">ID: #{entity.id}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        )}

        {/* Acciones de Exportación */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Download className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" />
              {t("compliance.traceability.exportEvidence", "Export Evidence")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => handleExportEvidence("JSON")}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.exportJSON", "Export JSON")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => handleExportEvidence("PDF")}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                {t("compliance.traceability.exportPDF", "Export PDF")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
```
